---
title: "蒙提霍尔问题"
subtitle: "STAT2002 · 条件概率"
page-layout: full
toc: false
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <meta name="description" content="通过三门问题比较坚持与换门策略的获胜概率。">
---

```{=html}
<div class="mh-lab" id="mh-lab">
  <header class="mh-intro">
    <a class="mh-back" href="stat2002.html">← 返回 STAT2002</a>
    <div class="mh-rule-box">
      <span class="mh-rule-label">游戏规则</span>
      <ol class="mh-rule-steps">
        <li><span id="mh-rule-count">三</span>扇门后藏着一辆车，其余门后都是羊，请先选一扇门。</li>
        <li>主持人知道奖品位置，会从其余门中打开一扇藏有羊的门。</li>
        <li>你可以坚持原来的选择，也可以亲自改选其余未打开的任意一扇门。</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="mh-workbench">
    <section class="mh-stage" aria-labelledby="mh-stage-title">
      <div class="mh-stage-heading">
        <div>
          <span class="mh-eyebrow">MONTY HALL</span>
          <h2 id="mh-stage-title">选一扇门</h2>
          <p id="mh-instruction" aria-live="polite">汽车就在其中一扇门后。你的第一选择是哪一扇？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="mh-stage-tools">
          <fieldset class="mh-door-count">
            <legend>门的数量</legend>
            <label><input type="radio" name="mh-door-count" value="3" checked><span>3 扇</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="mh-door-count" value="4"><span>4 扇</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="mh-door-count" value="5"><span>5 扇</span></label>
          </fieldset>
          <span class="mh-round" id="mh-round">第 1 轮</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mh-doors" id="mh-doors" aria-label="三扇可选择的门">
        <button class="mh-door" type="button" data-door="0" aria-label="选择 1 号门">
          <span class="mh-door-frame">
            <span class="mh-prize" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="mh-door-face"><span class="mh-door-number">1</span><i class="mh-knob"></i></span>
          </span>
          <span class="mh-door-caption">1 号门</span>
        </button>
        <button class="mh-door" type="button" data-door="1" aria-label="选择 2 号门">
          <span class="mh-door-frame">
            <span class="mh-prize" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="mh-door-face"><span class="mh-door-number">2</span><i class="mh-knob"></i></span>
          </span>
          <span class="mh-door-caption">2 号门</span>
        </button>
        <button class="mh-door" type="button" data-door="2" aria-label="选择 3 号门">
          <span class="mh-door-frame">
            <span class="mh-prize" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="mh-door-face"><span class="mh-door-number">3</span><i class="mh-knob"></i></span>
          </span>
          <span class="mh-door-caption">3 号门</span>
        </button>
        <button class="mh-door" type="button" data-door="3" aria-label="选择 4 号门" hidden>
          <span class="mh-door-frame">
            <span class="mh-prize" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="mh-door-face"><span class="mh-door-number">4</span><i class="mh-knob"></i></span>
          </span>
          <span class="mh-door-caption">4 号门</span>
        </button>
        <button class="mh-door" type="button" data-door="4" aria-label="选择 5 号门" hidden>
          <span class="mh-door-frame">
            <span class="mh-prize" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="mh-door-face"><span class="mh-door-number">5</span><i class="mh-knob"></i></span>
          </span>
          <span class="mh-door-caption">5 号门</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="mh-decision" id="mh-decision" hidden>
        <p>主持人打开了一扇有羊的门。现在你要——</p>
        <div class="mh-decision-buttons">
          <button type="button" class="mh-strategy-choice mh-stay" id="mh-stay">
            <span class="mh-choice-icon" aria-hidden="true">●</span>
            <span><strong>坚持不换</strong><small id="mh-stay-copy">保留原来的门</small></span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="mh-strategy-choice mh-switch" id="mh-switch">
            <span class="mh-choice-icon" aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            <span><strong>选择换门</strong><small id="mh-switch-copy">自己挑选另一扇门</small></span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mh-result" id="mh-result" hidden aria-live="polite">
        <div class="mh-result-icon" id="mh-result-icon" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div>
          <strong id="mh-result-title"></strong>
          <p id="mh-result-copy"></p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="mh-next" id="mh-next">再来一轮</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <aside class="mh-sidebar" aria-label="实验统计">
      <section class="mh-scoreboard">
        <div class="mh-score-heading">
          <div>
            <span class="mh-eyebrow">本次实验</span>
            <h2>策略记录</h2>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="mh-reset" id="mh-reset">清空</button>
        </div>

        <div class="mh-total">
          <span>已完成</span>
          <strong id="mh-total">0</strong>
          <small>轮</small>
        </div>

        <div class="mh-strategy-list">
          <div class="mh-strategy mh-strategy-stay">
            <div class="mh-strategy-title"><span>坚持</span><strong id="mh-stay-rate">—</strong></div>
            <div class="mh-meter"><i id="mh-stay-meter"></i></div>
            <p><span id="mh-stay-wins">0</span> 次获胜 / <span id="mh-stay-total">0</span> 次选择</p>
          </div>
          <div class="mh-strategy mh-strategy-switch">
            <div class="mh-strategy-title"><span>换门</span><strong id="mh-switch-rate">—</strong></div>
            <div class="mh-meter"><i id="mh-switch-meter"></i></div>
            <p><span id="mh-switch-wins">0</span> 次获胜 / <span id="mh-switch-total">0</span> 次选择</p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </section>

      <details class="mh-tip" id="mh-tip">
        <summary>
          <span class="mh-tip-bulb" aria-hidden="true">💡</span>
          <span class="mh-tip-label">TIPS</span>
          <span class="mh-tip-toggle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </summary>
        <div class="mh-tip-body">
          <p id="mh-explanation">第一次选中汽车的概率只有 1/3；选中羊的概率是 2/3。主持人排除一扇有羊的门后，换门会在最初选中羊的所有情形中获胜。</p>
        </div>
      </details>
    </aside>
  </div>
</div>
```

<script src="monty-hall-lab.js"></script>
